client_faqs.question: Where is your shop or consultancy located?
client_faqs.answer: Anshu Computer & Tax Consultancy is located at Kaushal Market, Rath Road, Orai, Uttar Pradesh, India. Open Monday to Saturday from 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM.

client_faqs.question: What are your service charges?
client_faqs.answer: Our service charges are highly affordable and depend on the specific work (ITR Filing, GST Registration, or PF Claim Resolution). For a quick transparent quote, call/WhatsApp us at +91 7217646673 or visit our consultancy in Kaushal Market, Orai.

client_faqs.question: What services do you offer?
client_faqs.answer: Our services are structured into 4 main categories: 1) PF Consultancy (Primary Specialization: PF Claim Settlement Forms 19/10C/31, UAN Consolidation, KYC Correction, Name/DOB Correction, Joint Declaration, Ex-Employer Cases), 2) Tax Services (Income Tax Return - ITR Filing, Tax Computation, Notice Assistance), 3) GST Services (New GST Registration, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B Monthly Filing), and 4) General Services (All other offered services differing from PF, Tax, and GST: MSME Udyam, Jeevan Pramaan Life Certificate, Passport Online, PAN Card, Sevayojan).

client_faqs.question: What documents are required for PF Withdrawal or Correction?
client_faqs.answer: For PF claim settlement or KYC correction, please bring your Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque, UAN Number, and registered Mobile Number.

client_faqs.question: What documents are required for ITR Filing?
client_faqs.answer: For Income Tax Return filing, please bring Form 16 (if salaried), Bank Statements for the financial year, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, and investment proof documents.

client_faqs.question: Do you provide Aadhaar card update or correction services?
client_faqs.answer: No. We strictly DO NOT provide any Aadhaar Card services (no update, no biometric, no enrollment). Aadhaar Card is only required as an identity proof document for clients getting PF, Tax, GST, or PAN services done.
